sections.installation:
Plugin Installation:

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins -> Add New
  3. Search for ‘Keyideas Jewelry Configurator’
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate
  5. The plugin will appear in your WordPress left side menu

Plugin Link: Keyideas Jewelith – 3D Jewelry Configurator

Post-Installation Setup:

After activation, the plugin automatically creates a dedicated configurator page. You can preview this page by clicking “Open Page” from the plugin dashboard. For easier customer access, add this page to your store’s navigation menu.

Accessing the Plugin Dashboard:

After activation, click Jewelry Configurator from the WordPress left-side menu. From here, you can view and manage your plan, configure your configurator page, preview the live experience, and contact our support team for assistance.

Plugin Configuration:

Jewelith includes built-in 3D ring and bracelet models with stone, shank, and setting combinations ready to use out of the box. You can use these default models or add your own custom products (GLB models required) by contacting our team.

Note: Custom product configuration involves additional charges.
sections.faq:
What’s the difference between the free and paid versions?

The free version provides access to the Jewelith 3D Configurator with pre-loaded ring and bracelet models, interactive step-by-step customization, real-time 3D preview, multilingual and multi-currency support, customizable branding, and a mobile-optimized experience.

The paid version includes everything in the free version, plus add to cart functionality, placeholder pricing management, support for custom GLB ring and bracelet models, enhanced configuration capabilities, and priority support.

Do you offer refunds?

No. Refunds are not provided after payment or subscription activation because the setup process includes server setup, account configuration, configurator setup, and licensing.

How often does pricing change?

Pricing is reviewed periodically to reflect new features and improvements. Any pricing changes are communicated in advance.

What jewelry types can customers configure?

Jewelith currently covers rings and bracelets as its primary design categories.

What components and customization options are available?

For rings, customers can configure setting style, metal type, center stone, ring size, shank width and profile, and personalized engraving.

For bracelets, customers can configure chain style, charms and pendant attachments, bracelet length, and clasp style and finish.

Can I import my own jewelry models or components?

Yes. With the paid version, you can upload your own ring and bracelet models to the configurator. Models must be provided in GLB format.

What placeholder prices are set during the free trial?

During the trial, placeholder pricing is used for configured jewelry products so you can review the full customization flow and preview how products appear on the storefront.

How are configured products ordered?

When a customer completes the configuration process and adds the piece to the cart, the order can include the selected configuration options so you can review the customer’s exact specifications.

What if I don’t have my own ring or bracelet models?

You can start with the sample ring and bracelet models included in the configurator. You can later replace them with your own models in GLB format or use a product library add-on.

How does the 3D Jewelry Configurator help increase sales?

Interactive product customization can improve engagement and help customers build jewelry pieces to their preferences before purchase.

How can I customize the Jewelith Configurator?

You can add navigation menu links, adjust configuration steps, update placeholder pricing, manage which models appear in the studio, and control how products are added to the cart based on your setup.

What is the Concierge Mode?

Concierge mode allows your team to guide a customer through the design process in real time.

What is the Self-Serve Mode?

Self-serve mode is designed for customers who want to complete the full design flow on their own through a step-by-step interface.

How does the Shareable Design Link work?

Each design can generate a shareable URL that captures the selected jewelry specifications, allowing customers to revisit or share the design.

Can I customize the appearance to match my brand?

Yes. The plugin is designed to work with modern WordPress themes and WooCommerce, and the configurator experience can be aligned with your store branding.

Can I see examples of stores using the Jewelith Configurator?

Examples include:

  • https://www.bongioielli.com/3d-ring-studio/
  • https://anelladiamonds.com/pages/ring-customizer

What if the plugin doesn’t load properly with my theme?

If the configurator does not load correctly, make sure your theme supports WooCommerce properly. Theme-specific styling or layout adjustments may still be needed.

What permissions does the plugin require?

The plugin may require permissions related to products, orders, page creation, and WooCommerce settings depending on the enabled workflow.

How can I prevent search engines from indexing configurator products?

You can control indexing at the page level with an SEO plugin such as Yoast SEO or Rank Math by setting the configurator page or related product areas to noindex when needed.

What languages are supported?

The plugin supports multiple languages and is intended to work with multilingual setups.

Can I customize the text on configurator pages?

Yes. Text labels and interface terminology can be customized through the language and region setup, depending on your configuration.

What is Keyideas Ring Builder – Build Your Own Ring (BYOR)?

The Ring Builder is a complete WordPress & WooCommerce plugin that enables customers to design custom engagement rings. It offers access to an entire inventory of diamonds and gemstones (natural, lab-grown, and colored), advanced filtering, interactive ring building, and seamless integration with your existing store. The plugin is designed to increase sales by up to 30% through enhanced customer engagement.

Key Features:

  • Diamond selection from your inventory or connected suppliers (Nivoda, RapNet)
  • Complete customization: center stone shape, metal type, side accents, engraving
  • Live pricing updates as customers customize
  • 360° product views with interactive 3D ring visualization
  • Mobile-optimized with full functionality on all devices
  • Multi-language and multi-currency support

Why Jewelers Love It:

  • Increases average order value by 40% on custom rings
  • Reduces custom quote requests by 60%
  • Provides 24/7 self-service customization for engagement rings
  • Integrates with supplier feeds (RapNet, Nivoda)

Use Together: Many stores combine Jewelith for 3D custom rings or bracelets with charms, and Ring Builder for engagement ring design, offering customers full flexibility across all jewelry categories.

Learn More: WooCommerce Ring Builder by Keyideas

What is Keyideas Jewelry Filter and Search plugin?

Transform your jewelry store with powerful filter and search capabilities designed for ALL jewelry types: Engagement Rings, Wedding Bands, Fine Jewelry, Earrings, Necklaces, Bracelets, Pendants, and more. Help customers find their perfect jewelry piece 3x faster and increase sales by up to 30% with an intuitive, mobile-optimized shopping experience.

Learn More: Keyideas Jewelry Filter & Search

What is Keyideas Timenox: All-in-One Watch Integration & Smart Filter App?

Timenox helps jewelry stores expand into luxury watches with filtering for brand, model, dial, bracelet, bezel, size, condition, paper, and year, with mobile-friendly search and inventory support.

Learn More: Keyideas Timenox – Integrate Watches

What is Keyideas Vizora – Virtual Try-On?

Vizora allows customers to try on jewelry rings and bracelets virtually from home through an immersive WooCommerce-compatible shopping experience.

Learn More: Keyideas Vizora – 3D Try-On

Where can I find video tutorials?

Video tutorials are available inside the plugin interface under the help and support area.

How do I get support?

For support, custom features, or add-on inquiries, use the contact options provided within the plugin interface.

sections.description:
3D jewelry configurator for WordPress and WooCommerce with ring and bracelet customization.

Keyideas Jewelith – 3D Jewelry Configurator Plugin Overview

Elevate your jewelry store with Jewelith, the 3D Jewelry Configurator for WordPress and WooCommerce. It enables customers to design and personalize rings and bracelets through an interactive, step-by-step configuration experience with real-time 3D previews without leaving your website.

The plugin integrates with your WooCommerce store, allowing you to offer custom jewelry products with flexible configuration options including engraving, metal selection, stone choice, and ring sizing. Jewelith is built to improve customer engagement and create a modern custom jewelry shopping experience.

View the Demo:

  • Rings
  • Bracelets

What Makes Our 3D Jewelry Configurator Unique

Complete jewelry customization experience with real-time 3D visualization, dynamic pricing updates, and WordPress plus WooCommerce integration. Customers can rotate, zoom, and inspect each design detail in a lifelike 3D render before placing their order. The configurator supports both a guided concierge mode and an independent self-serve mode, with both paths resulting in a fully specified custom piece. The experience is responsive, mobile-friendly, and supports multiple languages and currencies.

Free Version Features

  • Access to the Jewelith 3D Configurator with pre-loaded ring and bracelet models
  • Interactive step-by-step customization experience
  • Real-time 3D product preview with rotate and zoom support
  • Multilingual and multi-currency support
  • Customizable design to match your brand
  • Mobile-optimized interface

Note: Add to Cart functionality and advanced configuration features are available in the paid version.

Paid Version Features

  • Add to Cart functionality for configured jewelry products
  • Ability to update and manage placeholder pricing for configured products
  • Option to upload custom ring and bracelet models in GLB format
  • Enhanced customization support for more complex jewelry configurations
  • Priority support from the Jewelith team

Pricing

Annual Subscription: $500/year – Introductory Offer
One-time Setup Fee: $300-$500 based on website complexity
Payment Method: Wire transfer only

One-Time Setup Fee Coverage

The setup fee includes plugin installation and configuration, theme compatibility testing and adjustments, configurator integration with your store, and workflow testing and quality assurance. Setup typically takes 3-5 business days.

Available Paid Add-ons

  • Custom 3D Model Preparation: preparation and optimization of your existing ring or bracelet designs for use in the configurator, with GLB format required
  • Product Library: a library of ready-to-use ring and bracelet 3D models for faster launch
  • Custom Platform Integration: hosted configurator deployment for BigCommerce, Magento (Adobe Commerce), or PrestaShop

Contact the Keyideas team through the plugin interface for pricing and custom feature requests.
